info.description:
# Glyph API

Glyph indexes Qubic by connecting straight to peers and verifying quorum evidence. There is no hosted RPC in the path: every tick, transaction, and event served here came from peer messages that Glyph fetched, aligned, and persisted itself.

## Response shape

Every JSON response wraps its payload in `data`. Collections also return `meta` with pagination fields. Errors use RFC 9457 problem documents and a stable `code`.

## Two read paths

- Indexed routes under `/v1` read ClickHouse and return only quorum-verified, persisted history.
- Live routes under `/v1/live` make a direct peer call per request. They may use a short 2-second cache and return `503 unavailable` when no peer answers.

## Conventions

- Amounts are integer QUBIC in the network's base unit. 1 QUBIC is 1 base unit and is never rescaled.
- Identities are uppercase base-26. Transaction hashes are lowercase base-26. Tick and epoch numbers are JSON integers.
- Newest-first collections accept `limit` and an opaque `cursor` from `meta.next_cursor`.
- `/v1/status` reports ingest and network progress. `/status` renders the same state as HTML.
info.summary: A direct-peer read API for the Qubic network.

post.description:
Requires ALLOW_BROADCAST=true. The transaction is decoded and locally checked for amount range, input size, byte length, and SchnorrQ signature before any socket is opened. Valid transactions are fanned out concurrently to up to `peers` peers (capped by BROADCAST_PEERS). Set `dry_run` to run the same checks without broadcasting.

Qubic does not acknowledge broadcasts. A `sent` peer means the packet reached the peer socket, not that the transaction will be included. Poll `meta.links.transaction`, or stream ticks, to observe inclusion.
